title: 粵語 · 語氣助詞 Particles
subtitle: The 33 sentence-final particles on jyutping.org/en/blog/particles, everyday ones first · examples written for Kotoba

groups.name: 啊／呀 aa3
groups.note: The all-purpose softener. On a question it sounds friendlier; on a statement it adds warmth or emphasis; after items in a list it separates them. After a vowel it often becomes 呀 (same sound).

items.roman: nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 aa3?
hou2 hou2 sik6 aa3!

items.text: 蘋果呀、橙呀、香蕉呀，乜都有。
items.roman: ping4 gwo2 aa3, caang2 aa3, hoeng1 ziu1 aa3, mat1 dou1 jau5.
items.translation: Apples, oranges, bananas — they have everything.
items.mandarin: 蘋果啊、橙子啊、香蕉啊，什麼都有。

groups.name: 呢 ne1
groups.note: "How about…?" after a noun (你呢？), "where is…?" on its own noun (我部電話呢？), and a gentle marker on wh-questions. Also pronounced le1.

items.roman: ngo5 hou2 gui6, nei5 ne1?
ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 ne1?
dim2 gaai2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 lei4 ne1?
items.translation: Why didn't he come today, I wonder?

groups.name: 嘅 ge3
groups.note: Marks a statement as a fact or a settled judgment, like Mandarin 的 at the end of 是…的. Very common after 係 and adjectives.

items.roman: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 ngo5 maa4 maa1 maai5 ge3.
items.translation: This top was bought by my mum.
items.mandarin: 這件衣服是我媽媽買的。

items.roman: keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 lei4 ge3.
ngo5 m4 sik6 laat6 ge3.
items.translation: I don't eat spicy food (that's just how I am).

groups.name: 啦 laa1
groups.note: Requests, suggestions and urging: "come on", "let's". Also agreement (好啦 okay then) and listing examples.

items.roman: faai3 di1 laa1, zau6 lei4 ci4 dou3 laa3!
items.translation: Hurry up, we're about to be late!

items.roman: jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
hou2 laa1 hou2 laa1, ngo5 teng1 nei5 gong2 laa1.
items.translation: Okay, okay, I'll do what you say.

groups.name: 喇 laa3
groups.note: Something has changed or is about to: "now", "already". Mandarin 了 at the end of a sentence.

items.roman: lok6 jyu5 laa3!
ngo5 sik6 baau2 laa3.
gau3 zung1 laa3, zau2 laa1.

groups.name: 㗎 gaa3
groups.note: 嘅 ge3 + 啊 aa3 fused: an explanation or a firm "that's the way it is", often a bit emphatic. As a question (㗎？) it asks for confirmation or shows surprise.

items.roman: ni1 dou6 m4 ho2 ji5 sik6 jin1 gaa3.
items.translation: You can't smoke here, you know.

items.roman: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
nei5 zan1 hai6 sik1 gong2 jat6 man2 gaa3?

groups.name: 咩 me1
groups.note: A yes/no question expecting or showing surprise: "Don't tell me…?", "Really?". Different from 咩 me1 meaning "what" inside a sentence.

items.roman: nei5 m4 zi1 me1?
items.mandarin: 你不知道嗎？（難道不知道？）

items.roman: keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1 me1?
gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 me1?
items.translation: You don't have to go to work today?

groups.name: 嗎 maa3
groups.note: The plain yes/no question particle, like Mandarin 嗎, but less common in speech than 去唔去 (V-not-V). Also maa1 in some greetings.

items.roman: nei5 hou2 maa3?
nei5 ming4 baak6 maa3?
ni1 dou6 jau5 waai1 faai1 maa3?

groups.name: 喎 wo3
groups.note: Points out something the speaker has just noticed or wants you to notice: "oh!", "mind you". Also passes on what someone said.

items.roman: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6 wo3.
items.mandarin: 這家餐廳還挺好吃的喔。

items.roman: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 dou6 wo3.
siu2 sam1 di1 wo3, dei6 haa2 hou2 waat6.
items.translation: Be careful, mind you — the floor's slippery.

groups.name: 囉 lo1
groups.note: "Obviously", "just do it then": a slightly impatient or matter-of-fact conclusion.

items.roman: m4 zung1 ji3 mai6 m4 hou2 sik6 lo1.
items.translation: If you don't like it, then just don't eat it.

items.roman: keoi5 beng6 zo2, so2 ji5 mou5 lei4 lo1.
items.translation: He was sick, so obviously he didn't come.

items.roman: gam2 nei5 zi6 gei2 heoi3 lo1.

groups.name: 咋 zaa3
groups.note: "Only", "just" — the amount or situation is small. Often with 得…咋 or 先…咋.

items.roman: ngo5 dak1 sap6 man1 zaa3.
keoi5 sin1 saam1 seoi3 zaa3.
hoi1 wun6 siu3 zaa3, m4 hou2 nau1 laa1.
items.translation: It's only a joke, don't be mad.

groups.name: 啫 ze1
groups.note: Plays something down: "it's just…", "only", "no big deal".

items.roman: siu2 si6 ze1, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
items.translation: It's just a small thing, don't worry.

items.roman: ngo5 man6 haa5 ze1.
keoi5 gong2 siu3 ze1, nei5 mai5 dong3 zan1.
items.translation: He's only kidding, don't take it seriously.
items.mandarin: 他只是開玩笑，你別當真。

groups.name: 吖 aa1
groups.note: Makes a request or offer friendly (唔該…吖), or shows ready agreement (好吖). Also a mildly sarcastic "sure, go ahead".

items.roman: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 seoi2 ngo5 aa1.
items.translation: Could you give me a glass of water, please?

items.roman: hou2 aa1, jat1 cai4 heoi3 aa1.
nei5 si3 haa5 aa1.
items.translation: Go on, give it a try.

groups.name: 嘛 maa3／maa5
groups.note: "It's obvious, isn't it" — gives a reason the listener should already accept. Not a question particle.

items.text: 佢係你朋友嘛，幫吓佢啦。
items.roman: keoi5 hai6 nei5 pang4 jau5 maa3, bong1 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
items.translation: He's your friend, after all — help him out.
items.mandarin: 他是你朋友嘛，幫幫他吧。

items.roman: lok6 gan2 jyu5 maa3, gang2 hai6 sak1 ce1 laa1.
items.translation: It's raining, so of course there's traffic.
items.mandarin: 正在下雨嘛，當然塞車啦。

items.roman: ngo5 dou1 waa6 zo2 m4 dak1 maa3.
items.translation: I told you it wouldn't work, didn't I.

groups.name: 啩 gwaa3
groups.note: Uncertainty: "I suppose", "probably". Often with 應該 or 可能.

items.roman: keoi5 jing1 goi1 dou3 zo2 uk1 kei2 gwaa3.
items.translation: He's probably home by now, I guess.

items.roman: m4 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gwaa3.
items.translation: It won't rain, I don't think.

items.roman: daai6 koi3 ng5 dim2 gwaa3.

groups.name: 添 tim1
groups.nameEn: too, as well; and on top of that
groups.note: "Also, in addition" (再食多碗添); or "on top of it all" for something surprising or unfortunate.

items.roman: zoi3 lai4 jat1 wun2 tim1.
keoi5 sik1 gong2 faat3 man2 tim1.
items.translation: She can even speak French too.

items.roman: m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1, lok6 jyu5 tim1!
items.translation: Forgot my umbrella — and now it's raining!
items.mandarin: 忘了帶傘，還下起雨來了！

groups.name: 嘞 laak3
groups.note: Confirms or settles something: "right", "that's it then". Close to 喇 but firmer; also lak3 / la3.

items.text: 係嘞，你記唔記得帶鎖匙？
items.roman: hai6 laak3, nei5 gei3 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4?
items.translation: Oh right, did you remember the keys?

items.roman: dak1 laak3, ngo5 zi1 dou3 laak3.
ngo5 zau2 sin1 laak3, baai1 baai3.

groups.name: 咯 lok3
groups.note: Something is finished or already settled; can sound like "I've told you already". Also lo3.

items.roman: ngo5 dou1 waa6 zo2 hai6 gam2 lok3.
items.translation: I already said that's how it is.

items.roman: gaau2 dim6 lok3, ho2 ji5 zau2 lok3.
items.translation: All done — we can go now.

items.roman: mou5 gai2 lok3.

groups.name: 噃 bo3
groups.note: A reminder or warning (喎 wo3 + stronger): "don't forget", "mind you".

items.roman: gei3 dak1 sik6 joek6 bo3.
items.translation: Remember to take your medicine, okay?

items.roman: nei5 m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 bo3.
hou2 dung3 bo3, zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1.
items.translation: It's cold, mind — put on another layer.
items.mandarin: 很冷喔，多穿一件衣服吧。

groups.name: 吓 haa2
groups.note: At the start: "Huh? What?" — surprise or asking to repeat. At the end: "right?", checking agreement.

items.roman: haa2? keoi5 ci4 zo2 zik1?
haa2, gam2 dou1 dak1?
nei5 ting1 jat6 wui5 lei4 haa2?

groups.name: 嗬 ho2
groups.note: "Right?", "isn't it?" — asks the listener to agree with something both of you know.

items.roman: gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6 ho2?
nei5 hai6 san1 lei4 ge3 ho2?
gam2 zau6 gau3 laak3 ho2?

groups.name: 嚱 he2
groups.note: Like 嗬, asks for agreement, often with a little feeling or admiration: "…isn't it!"

items.roman: ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 hou2 tai2 he2?
items.translation: This film's pretty good, isn't it?
items.mandarin: 這部電影挺好看的，是吧？

items.roman: keoi5 di1 zi6 hou2 leng3 he2?
items.translation: Her handwriting is lovely, isn't it?

items.roman: gam1 maan5 go3 jyut6 gwong1 hou2 jyun4 he2?
items.translation: The moon's so round tonight, isn't it?

groups.name: 呀 aa4
groups.note: Low-falling aa4: surprise or checking what you heard — "so you mean…?"

items.roman: gam2 m4 tung1 mat1 dou1 m4 sai2 zou6 aa4?
items.translation: So we don't have to do anything at all?
items.mandarin: 那難道什麼都不用做了？

items.roman: nei5 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 hok6 aa4?
items.translation: You're not going to school today?

items.roman: keoi5 hai6 nei5 go4 go1 aa4?

groups.name: 嘎 gaa4
groups.note: The surprised question form of 㗎: "so it's…?", "really?"

items.roman: jyun4 loi4 jiu3 sau1 cin2 gaa4?
ni1 di1 hai6 nei5 zou6 gaa4?
keoi5 dei6 hai6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 gaa4?

groups.name: 𠺢／咖 gaa1
groups.note: Explains how things normally are, sometimes as advice: "that's how it should be".

items.roman: gam2 sin1 ngaam1 gaa1 maa3.
items.translation: That's the right way, you see.

items.roman: san1 sau2 hai6 gam2 gaa1 laa1.
items.translation: Beginners are like that, that's normal.

items.roman: ni1 di1 je5 jiu3 maan6 maan2 lei4 gaa1.
items.translation: These things take time, that's how it is.

groups.name: 𠿪 gaa2
groups.note: Questions a condition or checks with doubt: "only if…, right?"

items.roman: cin4 tai4 hai6 zou6 dak1 ceot1 sin1 dak1 gaa2?
items.translation: Only if it can be done, right?
items.mandarin: 前提是做得出來才行，是吧？

items.roman: jiu3 jyu6 joek3 sin1 jap6 dak1 gaa2?
items.translation: You can only go in with a booking?

items.roman: jiu3 paai4 deoi2 gaa2?
items.translation: We have to queue, do we?

groups.name: 𠺝／嗝 gaak3
groups.note: "You know very well…" — reminding the listener of something they should already know (嘅 + 㗎 + 嘞 feeling).

items.roman: nei5 ping4 si4 hou2 jam2 dak1 gaak3.
items.translation: You usually drink a lot, you know you do.

items.roman: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 zeon2 si4 gaak3.
ni1 dou6 sing1 kei4 jat1 m4 hoi1 gaak3.
items.translation: It's closed on Mondays here, you know.

groups.name: 咧 le4
groups.note: Offers or proposes, often a bit coaxing or teasing: "then how about…?"

items.roman: ngo5 sung3 nei5 jat1 zoeng1 hei3 fei1 le4?
items.translation: What if I gave you a movie ticket?
items.mandarin: 我送你一張電影票怎麼樣？

items.roman: m4 heoi3 zau6 m4 heoi3 le4.
items.translation: If you don't want to go, then don't.

items.roman: nei5 si3 haa5 sin1 le4.
items.translation: How about you try it first?

groups.name: 哩 le5
groups.note: Insists on the truth of what you say: "honestly", "I'm telling you".

items.roman: ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 ngaak1 nei5 le5.
items.translation: I honestly didn't lie to you.

items.roman: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 jan4 le5.
items.translation: He really is a good guy, I'm telling you.

items.roman: ngo5 mou5 ling1 nei5 di1 je5 le5.
items.translation: I didn't take your stuff, honestly.

groups.name: 囖 lo4
groups.note: Agrees emphatically or treats something as obvious: "of course", "exactly".

items.roman: hai6 lo4, dim2 gaai2 nei5 zi6 gei2 m4 heoi3?
items.translation: Exactly — so why don't you go yourself?
items.mandarin: 就是啊，你為什麼不自己去？

items.roman: gang2 hai6 lo4!
zau6 hai6 keoi5 lo4.

groups.name: 嚕 lou3
groups.note: A newly completed state, like 咯/喇: "there, done".

items.roman: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 lou3.
dou3 zaam6 lou3, lok6 ce1 laa1.
items.translation: We're at the stop — get off.

items.roman: tin1 gwong1 lou3.

groups.name: 啝／咊 wo4
groups.note: Realising something new: "oh, so…", "turns out".

items.roman: pin1 man4 jyun4 loi4 hai6 keoi5 se2 ge3 wo4.
items.translation: Oh, so it turns out he wrote the article.
items.mandarin: 原來那篇文章是他寫的啊。

items.roman: jyun4 loi4 nei5 sik1 keoi5 wo4.
gam1 jat6 jyun4 loi4 hai6 keoi5 saang1 jat6 wo4.
items.translation: Oh, it turns out it's her birthday today.

groups.name: 𡁜／唩 wo5
groups.note: Passes on what someone else said: "he says…", "apparently".

items.roman: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 heoi3 wo5.
ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 fung1 wo5.
lou5 baan2 waa6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 ou1 ti1 wo5.
items.translation: The boss says we have to work overtime tonight.

groups.name: 喳 zaa4
groups.note: The surprised question form of 咋: "only…?"

items.roman: zau6 dak1 gam3 do1 zaa4?
sap6 man1 zaa4? gam3 peng4!
nei5 sin1 faan1 lei4 zaa4?

groups.name: 唧 zek1
groups.note: Presses a question, sometimes impatiently: "what on earth…?"

items.roman: gau3 ging2 faat3 sang1 zo2 me1 si6 zek1?
nei5 gong2 mat1 zek1?
sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 zek1?
items.translation: Is there any need to be so nervous?

groups.name: 𡅅 aak3
groups.note: Firm insistence, often with a negative: "it's not, okay?"

items.roman: m4 hai6 aak3!
ngo5 mou5 gong2 gwo3 aak3.
m4 dak1 aak3, taai3 ngai4 him2.

groups.name: 嗱 naa4
groups.note: Sentence-initial: draws attention — "look", "here", "now listen".

items.roman: naa4, zau6 hai2 ni1 dou6.
naa4, ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2.
items.translation: Now listen, let me tell you.

items.roman: naa4, bei2 nei5.

groups.name: 㗎喇・㗎嘛・咋嘛・啦嘛
groups.note: Particles stack, each adding its shade: 㗎喇 (it's so, now), 㗎嘛 (it's so, obviously), 咋嘛 (only, you know), 啦嘛 (come on, obviously).

items.roman: keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2 gaa3 laa3.

items.text: 佢係老師㗎嘛，梗係識啦。
items.roman: keoi5 hai6 lou5 si1 gaa3 maa3, gang2 hai6 sik1 laa1.
items.translation: He's a teacher, of course he knows.

items.roman: ngo5 man6 haa5 zaa3 maa3, m4 sai2 gam3 ok3.
items.translation: I was only asking — no need to be so fierce.
items.mandarin: 我只是問問而已嘛，不用這麼兇。
